meta.source: estivo63.ru and estivo63.ru/promo (Tilda), computed styles read 2026-10-20
meta.corrected: Corrected against MARKETING_AUDIT.md on 2026-10-22: type floor 14px, body 16px, tap-min, accent role.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every Zero block on estivo63.ru.

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Promo page ground, modal and form panels.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Review and advantage tiles, alternate promo sections. No border on these tiles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The brand's dark brown: all headings and body copy on surface, surface-white and surface-muted (16:1). Also the 1px card outline.

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Promo page headings and step titles on surface-white and surface-muted.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary heading ('Что выбрать') and philosophy paragraphs on surface.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Fill of the main dark button and input text. Text on it: on-dark (12.6:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Logo rust. Eyebrow labels, phone number, material names, outline call button. On surface 5.8:1, fine at any size.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta of the request button ('Получить расчёт') and the sale strip, which never opens the page (audit R13). Button labels on it use on-accent (5.4:1); on-dark (3.1:1) only for 40px+ banner type.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels above contact values ('Телефон', 'Адрес и режим работы') and review signatures on surface (5.1:1).

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: 1px border of form inputs. 1.7:1 on surface: below the 3:1 control-border floor, kept as in the source.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on graphite (12.6:1) and photo overlays; on accent only for 40px+ banner type (3.1:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Button labels on accent ('Получить расчёт', promo header button): 5.4:1. Accessible replacement for the source's white labels.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind popups (consultation form, cookie notice).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Home hero, set UPPERCASE, color ink.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Every home section heading, UPPERCASE, color ink, under an eyebrow.

styles.name: promo-cover
styles.usage: Promo cover title over a photo, color on-dark.

styles.name: promo-title
styles.usage: Promo section headings, UPPERCASE, color ink-black.

styles.name: material-title
styles.usage: Material names in the 'Что выбрать' block, UPPERCASE, color brand.

styles.name: promo-note
styles.sample: Акция: кофейный столик для всех новых клиентов

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Sale strip only, UPPERCASE, on-dark on accent; placed after the product screens, never first (audit R13). Scales down below 768px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Преимущества, которые говорят сами за себя:
styles.usage: Promo intro line under a promo-title, color graphite.

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Promo step and service names, UPPERCASE, ink-black.

styles.name: body-loose
styles.usage: Standalone links under review blocks, ink-soft.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All paragraph copy, color ink. 16px is the floor for body text on phones (audit R22).

styles.name: contact-accent
styles.usage: One emphasised line in contacts, UPPERCASE, brand.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above every section-title, sentence case, brand.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels above contact values, review signatures (muted) and legal footnotes (ink). 14px is the site minimum.

styles.name: promo-button
styles.usage: Small header button on the promo page, UPPERCASE, on accent.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between grid modules and cards (two modules + gutter = 458px).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of inputs and the large call button.

tokens.name: module
tokens.usage: One grid column: advantage cards, small photos, review tiles are 1, 2 or 3 modules wide.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Content width: five modules and four gutters, centred in a 1200px row.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of any tap target: header icons, slider arrows, small buttons (audit R22).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, cards, tiles and outlined cards: the site is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Promo header button and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: All primary buttons and form inputs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Cookie notice 'Хорошо' button only.
